PORT.description: HTTP port Railway routes to. Must match BICHON_HTTP_PORT.

BICHON_HTTP_PORT.description: Internal HTTP port the Bichon server listens on. Must match PORT.

BICHON_ROOT_DIR.description: Absolute path for all persistent data. Mounted as a Railway volume at /data.

BICHON_ENCRYPT_PASSWORD.description: REQUIRED. Password used to encrypt stored credentials (IMAP passwords, OAuth tokens). Auto-generated a random 32-char secret per deployment — keep it to access stored accounts later; changing it locks out stored accounts.

BICHON_PUBLIC_URL.description: Public URL for OAuth redirects and docs links. Auto-resolves to your Railway domain. Override for custom domains.
